name: Merger Integration
description: Two healthcare tech companies completed a merger 6 months ago. Significant role duplication, overlapping team structures, and culture friction. Integration requires thoughtful consolidation while preserving unique capabilities from both legacy organizations.
challenges: Two CTO-equivalent roles, two product leadership structures
Duplicate backend teams building competing implementations
Clinical team: unique HIPAA expertise from legacy org at risk
Combined sales headcount 70% above optimal for territory coverage
